name: This Is Going to Be Hard
label: Quest
description: Lotwil Veriatus declares the shackles finished and calls on Lucien, Servo and you to bear witness as a powerful elemental is summoned.
intro: Lotwil Veriatus declares the shackles finished and calls on Lucien, Servo and you to bear witness as a powerful elemental is summoned.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Haha! Done! The shackles are done!
It's time, Lucien. It's time, Servo!
Are you ready to bear witness to the perfect blend of alchemy, engineering, and the arcane, friend?
I shall summon forth a powerful elemental now. This is a groundbreaking day for all of us.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Not quite the outcome I was expecting. Could you get my shackles back?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. That was quite an ordeal, wasn't it?
I'm not sure what could have gone wrong. It was a good thing my magics were here to help send the creature back to its home plane.
Perhaps a little token of appreciation for all your hard work...
